svg.title: Ceduljica · eight mobile paper-plaza screens
svg.desc: Eight 390 by 844 mobile references preserve entry, how-to, lobby, writing, ready, waiting and reconnect, one-note reveal and a twelve-note vertical board with deletion. Broad curved fields replace miniature scenery. Original Ceduljica pals sit outside the authored calm paper surfaces. Focus, mute, ownership and reduced-motion guidance are visible.

svg.text: 390 × 844 each · one calm paper task at a time · broad framing, not miniature desktop scenery

g.text: Primary action first; labelled inputs and errors.
Trap focus · Escape closes · restore opener.
Below 600 px: full-screen if controls won't fit.
Invite one more person to begin.
Guest: Waiting for the owner to begin.
🔒 Only you can see your note.
Ready stays in document flow, above People.
Keyboard never covers a fixed action bar.
Server Reveal replaces Ready if readiness wins.
No editor; no other note bodies.
Polite ownership update; new owner also sees
“You are now the owner” by Owner controls.
Mute persists; pressed toggle + accessible name.
No sound before gesture; state is always visible.
The room and every note will be
Notes 3–12 continue below; normal vertical scroll.
Owner controls follow the board, outside notes.
Cancel restores Delete room; board inert in modal.
44 px targets · 200% zoom / 320 px reflow · no horizontal page scroll · 500-character cards grow and wrap anywhere · phase-heading focus · polite updates, not a spoken countdown

Reduced motion: static motif, zero tilt/stagger; state feedback stays. Standard: canvas-only 48 s drift, pause while hidden. Decorative art aria-hidden; secondary pals disappear before content compresses.
